title: Mysterious figure lending covert assistance
next_chapter_hook: While Chen Ji was still processing this earth-shattering clue, a bizarre purple light suddenly shot across the distant horizon—it was a demonic path transmission talisman. The Holy Sect's actions came faster than anticipated.

text.content: Night wind cut like a blade as Tianqing Sect's lights wavered in the cold. Chen Ji sat alone in the Servants' Quarters, the jade slip before him emanating a cold glint yet remaining unopened. His fingers hovered above the jade slip, brow furrowed—instinct warned him that carelessly reading it might fall right into someone's trap. Just then, a voice as faint as a mosquito's buzz suddenly reached his ear: 'Chen Ji, the jade slip is a trap, do not touch it lightly.' The voice was cold and low, indistinguishable as male or female, seemingly close as next to him yet far as the ends of the earth.

The voice seemed not to hear, continuing on its own: 'The one who reported you is named Zhou Heng, an Inner Sect administrative disciple. The evidence of your alleged secret dealings with the demonic path was 'discovered' three days ago by an elder of Xuanwu Sect, then handed to Tianqing Sect through imperial dark guards. That elder was precisely the one rejected by the Tianji Record twenty years ago—Ling Yuan's registered disciple.' As the words fell, Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. Someone rejected by the Tianji Record? What did this mean? Senior Mo had mentioned that the Tianji Record never chose its master arbitrarily; those it rejected were all qualified yet ultimately passed over.

dialogue.content: Who exactly are you? Why tell me these things?

text.content: After a moment of silence, the voice spoke again, this time with added complexity: 'You and I are not meeting for the first time. From the night you discovered the fragment in the scripture archive, to the time you evaded the Holy Sect's spies in the back mountain... do you truly believe those 'luck' instances were merely luck?' Chen Ji suddenly recalled the various crises he'd faced since entering the sect—behind each seemingly safe resolution, there always seemed to be an invisible hand manipulating the strings of fate. He'd always thought it was the Tianji Record's warnings at work, but now it seemed things were far more complicated.

'Zhou Heng has three major flaws.' The voice suddenly turned cold, 'First, he claims to have witnessed you trading with demonic cultivators, but in three years since your entry, you've never left the sect alone for even a moment—the 'witnessed time' he mentions, you were on duty at the servants' hall, with countless witnesses. Second, that 'discovered' demonic cultivation fragment, the residual energy is completely incompatible with your spiritual root attribute—anyone with cultivation can see it was deliberately forged. Third, and most critically...' The voice paused, as if considering, 'The connections behind him involve far more than Xuanwu Sect.'

Chen Ji's fingers tightened slightly. The Holy Sect. This name was like a thorn, deeply embedded in his heart. His younger sister Chen Nian had been taken by the Holy Sect, becoming the so-called 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key.' Was this accusation related to his sister? Or had the Holy Sect already discovered the existence of the Tianji Record? Various thoughts raced through his mind, yet Chen Ji's expression remained unruffled, his harmless waste appearance perfectly executed.

'The Holy Sect has sent people infiltrating Tianqing Sect.' The voice suddenly dropped a bombshell, 'Zhou Heng is merely the visible chess piece, the real chess player is currently hidden deep within the sect, waiting for the right moment. And that jade slip...' The voice dropped lower, 'What's sealed inside isn't any crucial intelligence, but a tracking restriction. Once your spiritual sense touches it, the Holy Sect can lock onto your position. Then—the secret of the Tianji Record will no longer be a secret.' Cold sweat broke out on Chen Ji's back. Had it not been for this mysterious figure's warning, he would have fallen into the trap right now.

choice.prompt: The intelligence provided by the mysterious figure was alarming, yet Chen Ji had never believed in windfalls. Faced with this sudden assistance, how should he decide?

choices.text: First clarify the other party's identity and intentions
choices.description: The mysterious figure knows too much, motives unclear, blindly trusting may bring disaster. First probe the other party's background, then decide whether to cooperate.
choices.risk_hint: The mysterious figure may lose patience

dialogue.content: Who exactly are you? We have no relation, why risk helping me?

text.content: The voice fell silent for a long while, so long Chen Ji thought the other party had left. Finally, a low sigh sounded at his ear: 'Some things, the time hasn't come, you shouldn't know. But I can tell you one thing—your sister Chen Nian is still alive.' This sentence exploded like thunder in Chen Ji's mind. His breathing suddenly quickened, his knuckles white from tension. Chen Nian... still alive?

choices.text: Unconditional trust, ask about next steps
choices.description: Since the other party has helped multiple times covertly without seeking reward, it shows their stance at least currently aligns with mine. First ride the momentum to break the situation, other matters can wait.
choices.risk_hint: If the other party is treacherous, it will be irreversible

dialogue.content: Since that's the case, what should I do?

text.content: 'Tomorrow at noon, Sect Master Ling Yuan will personally preside over your trial.' The voice was crisp and decisive. 'At that time, Zhou Heng will present the forged evidence before everyone, and you need only do one thing—request an on-the-spot spiritual verification. True demonic energy and forged energy will show completely different reactions under spiritual root resonance. Then, the truth will naturally come to light.' Chen Ji narrowed his eyes slightly. This plan seemed simple, yet each step was interlocked, every move stepping on Ling Yuan's sore spot—he wanted to see how the Sect Master would respond.

choices.text: Turn the tables, destroy the Jade Slip and set a counter-kill trap
choices.description: Since the Jade Slip is already known to be a trap, why not take the initiative to trigger it? Use this trap to counter-kill the mastermind behind the scenes, turning passivity into initiative
choices.visible_reward: Eliminate hidden dangers in advance, seize the initiative
choices.risk_hint: The Holy Sect's reaction is unpredictable

dialogue.content: The tracking formation within the Jade Slip... what if I use their own methods against them?

text.content: The voice suddenly carried a hint of a smile: "Interesting. What are you planning to do?" Chen Ji's lips curved slightly, revealing a cold smile utterly unlike his "waste" persona: "Formations are ultimately just a means of relaying information through borrowed power. If I infuse a fragment of the Tianji Record's energy signature into it and send it back to the sender——" He didn't finish, but the implication was clear. Let the Holy Sect's people taste the滋味 of being tracked by the Tianji Record. After a moment of silence, the voice let out a low approval: "Indeed one chosen by the Tianji Record. You have courage."

However, before the words finished, a subtle Spiritual Energy fluctuation suddenly came from outside the window. Chen Ji's expression slightly changed, and the mysterious voice immediately fell silent. A black shadow swept across the window lattice, its speed so fast that the outline was barely visible, yet it left a thin paper talisman on the ground. Chen Ji picked up the letter, on which eight characters were written in cinnabar——"Tomorrow at noon, Ling Yuan personally presides." At the edge of the paper, a trace of faint purple-black energy remained, which was the unique Spiritual Energy mark of the Demonic Path

Chen Ji stared at that strand of Demonic Path energy, his brow furrowed. The mysterious person had just mentioned that the Holy Sect had sent infiltrators into the Tianqing Sect—was this paper talisman left by the mysterious person, or a warning from the Holy Sect? Or was it a third force taking advantage of the chaos? The situation within the Tianqing Sect was far more complex than he had imagined. The Imperial Court, Xuanwu Sect, Holy Sect, mysterious forces... At least four factions had converged here, and he, this "waste," had unknowingly become a key piece on the chessboard

dialogue.content: Master Mo, since you've seen everything, could you give some substantive advice?

text.content: In his mind, the remnant soul of Master Mo on the first page of the Tianji Record sighed faintly: "Boy, this old man can only tell you one thing—that mysterious person's aura, this old man is, familiar with." Familiar? Chen Ji's heart stirred. Master Mo was an ancient great being with such vast experience—any existence that made him feel familiar was no ordinary person. Could this mysterious person actually be an old monster that existed since ancient times? Or was there some other hidden reason? Various speculations churned in his heart, but he forcefully suppressed them. In any case, tomorrow's trial was the top priority

The night grew deeper, and the bells of Tianqing Sect sounded悠悠, announcing that midnight had arrived. Chen Ji stored the Jade Slip and paper talisman together in his sleeve, sat cross-legged on the couch,表面上 seeming to practice the routine Tuna Breathing, but his mind had already sunk into the Tianji Record. The runes on the Fragment glowed faintly—the ability to foresee the future, though consuming five Heavenly Fate points each time, was his greatest reliance. If he could foresight several key scenes of tomorrow's trial in advance, perhaps he could find a thread of opportunity amidst the chaotic situation

However, just as he prepared to activate the Tianji Record, the Fragment suddenly vibrated violently. An unprecedented sense of crisis washed over him—as if something was watching him from the depths of fate. It was an indescribable pressure, more suffocating than when he faced Ling Yuan before. Then, an aged and majestic voice exploded in his mind: "Ant, how dare you peer into Heavenly Secrets?" Chen Ji's whole body froze, cold sweat instantly soaking his clothes. The Heavenly Dao's Eye... was this the projection of the final BOSS?!

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth and abruptly severed the Spiritual Sense connection with the Tianji Record. The pressure receded like a tide, and he collapsed onto the couch, gasping for breath. Master Mo's voice rang in his mind, carrying a hint of gravity: "Fortunately you reacted quickly. The Heavenly Dao's Eye's projection... it's already noticed you. That's not a good sign."

choices.text: Forcibly withstand the pressure and attempt communication
choices.description: Since the Heavenly Dao's Eye has already noticed him, instead of passively waiting, why not proactively probe the intentions of this ultimate existence
choices.visible_reward: May obtain key clues about the truth of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: May be instantly destroyed by the Heavenly Dao's Eye

text.content: Chen Ji did not retreat; instead, he lifted his head to meet that oppressive pressure. "Elder jest. Since the Tianji Record has chosen me as its master, divining heavenly secrets is merely my duty. If Elder has any instructions, please speak plainly." The moment his words fell, that oppressive pressure suddenly paused. Then, a meaningful laugh echoed in Chen Ji's mind: "Interesting... Truly interesting." The pressure receded like a tide, yet Chen Ji felt the world spinning before him—his Heavenly Fate had silently decreased by a full ten points.

When the eastern sky began to lighten, Chen Ji finally emerged from his meditation. Through a night of tossing and turning, though he failed to glimpse any visions of the future, he had sorted out many threads. The mysterious figure's appearance had exposed the Holy Sect—the puppeteer behind the scenes—to the light of day. And the unexpected descent of the Heavenly Dao's Eye made him realize that this chess piece of his might be far more significant than imagined. Ling Yuan, the Holy Sect, the Heavenly Dao's Eye... What connections existed between these forces?

At the third quarter of the Chen hour, the bell of the Servants' Hall rang, announcing the start of a new day. Chen Ji appeared at the edge of the Martial Arena as usual, carrying a broom, his timid demeanor no different from any other day. Yet as he passed the Inner Disciples' rest area, he "inadvertently" caught sight of a familiar figure—Zhou Heng. That Inner Sect steward who had reported him was now whispering with a middle-aged man in gray robes, his expression carrying a hint of flattery. The gray-robed man had his back turned to Chen Ji, but judging from his aura, he possessed at least late Foundation Building cultivation.

Chen Ji did not linger, continuing to sweep as if he had seen nothing. But his ears moved slightly, catching seven or eight parts of their conversation. "...The evidence is all prepared, absolutely certain. As long as we condemn thattrash today, the benefits the Sect Master promised will be yours." Zhou Heng's voice was pressed extremely low, yet it still drifted into Chen Ji's ears. The gray-robed man chuckled: "Relax, with the Sect Master presiding personally today, thattrash can't turn things around. But you—don't drop the ball at the critical moment." A subtle cold glint flickered across Chen Ji's lips—a desire to make him fall? That would depend on who flips first.

At the end of the Si hour, the great doors of the Law Enforcement Hall slowly opened. More than a dozen officials in blue robes filed out, arranging a massive Spiritual Energy barrier across the plaza before the hall. This was the "Truth Formation" used only when interrogating major criminals of the Tianqing Sect—anyone entering would be unable to lie. For a moment, numerous disciples stopped to watch, whispering about who the subject of today's interrogation might be. "I heard it's thattrash from the Servants' Hall..." "Whattrash?" "You know, that Chen Ji with the damaged spiritual root everyone's been mocking! I heard he colluded with the Demonic Path and is to be publicly executed!"

A majestic voice rang out from the depths of the Law Enforcement Hall. Chen Ji lifted his head to see green light descending from the heavens, landing on the Sect Master's throne at the hall's center. Ling Yuan—this old fox, seemingly the guardian of the Tianqing Sect but harboring treacherous intentions, had finally appeared. His gaze swept across the crowd before settling on Chen Ji, a faint, meaningful smile curving his lips. That smile sent a chill down Chen Ji's spine—just what was this old fox scheming?

Chen Ji walked slowly toward the center of the Law Enforcement Hall, his slender figure appearing especially desolate amid the whispers of the crowd. No one spoke in his defense, no one came to his aid—atrash after all, who would care? But Chen Ji himself knew that the true victory of this interrogation lay not in the gazes of these onlookers, but in the three trump cards in his hand—the three major vulnerabilities exposed by the mysterious figure, and his covert observations of Zhou Heng from last night. Did Ling Yuan want to watch him fall from grace? Did he want the Tianji Record to fall into the Holy Sect's hands? Then let him see who would be the final victor of this chess game.

Noon approached, the scorching sun hung high. Hundreds of disciples had gathered in the plaza before the Law Enforcement Hall, forming an impenetrable wall around the Truth Formation. Zhou Heng stepped out from the crowd, a delicate jade box held in his hands, his face wearing a confident smile. Inside that jade box lay the so-called "ironclad evidence"—a fragment of demonic cultivation technique. Chen Ji glanced at him, his gaze deep and still as an abyss. Last night the mysterious figure's words still echoed in his ears: three major vulnerabilities, on-the-spot spirit verification, truth revealed. He wanted to see exactly how Ling Yuan and Zhou Heng would save face when these vulnerabilities were publicly exposed.

The moment Chen Ji stepped into the Truth Formation, an strange energy immediately enveloped his entire body. This was the formation reading his basic intentions—if he spoke falsehood, the formation runes would emit a warning. Yet Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, even carrying a hint of fear and unease—a perfect performance of "wrongful accusation." Zhou Heng stepped forward triumphantly and declared loudly: "Reporting to the Sect Master, disciple Zhou Heng hereby formally accuses Servant Disciple Chen Ji of colluding with the Demonic Path and intending to subvert the Sect! Three days ago, disciple personally witnessed this person secretly trading with Demonic Path cultivators at the Rear Mountain—this matter is absolutely true!" The words fell, and an uproar immediately rose from the surroundings. Thetrash colluding with the Demonic Path? This was truly the joke of jokes.

choice.prompt: Zhou Heng's accusation had concluded, and Ling Yuan waited for Chen Ji's defense. Now was the time to uncover the truth—but in what manner?

dialogue.content: "Disciple respectfully requests the Sect Master to conduct an on-the-spot spirit verification!"

text.content: At these words, Ling Yuan's brow furrowed slightly, while Zhou Heng's expression changed. Chen Ji within the Truth Formation seemed oblivious to their unease, continuing: "Disciple may be atrash, but even so, disciple understands the meaning of innocence. If Brother Zhou's evidence is truly irrefutable, why not request the Sect Master to perform a public spirit verification? If that Demonic Path fragment truly bears disciple's spiritual energy, disciple willingly accepts punishment; if not, disciple begs the Sect Master to restore disciple's honor!" His voice was not loud, yet every word was clear, falling into the ears of every onlooker. The crowd began to stir, with someone shouting: "Verify! Verify!" Ling Yuan's gaze turned dark as deep water, yet he could not refuse this reasonable request.

choices.text: Proactively attack and expose Zhou Heng's three major vulnerabilities.
choices.description: Without waiting for the opponent's reaction, directly reveal the intelligence provided by the mysterious figure to catch them off guard.
choices.visible_cost: Expose the suspicious nature of the intelligence source.
choices.visible_reward: Completely shatter the opponent's psychological defenses.
choices.risk_hint: Speaking too detailed might raise new suspicions.

dialogue.content: "May I ask Brother Zhou, you claim to have personally witnessed me trading with a Demonic Path cultivator—but I wonder, when and where exactly was this?"

text.content: Zhou Heng froze, clearly not expecting thistrash to dare counter-question. He opened his mouth and said: "Of course it was three days ago, at the Xu hour, at the Rear Mountain Bamboo Grove—" Before he could finish, Chen Ji had already softly interrupted: "Three days ago at the Xu hour, disciple was on night duty at the Servants' Hall, with Steward Zhang Bo as witness. Brother Zhou's 'personal witnessing'—could it have been seen in a dream?" Zhou Heng's complexion underwent a dramatic change, cold sweat beading on his forehead. He had never expected this always-cowardlytrash to become so sharp-tongued today. The watching crowd began whispering, their gazes toward Zhou Heng turning suspicious. Ling Yuan's eyes grew increasingly gloomy, spiritual energy already condensing in his palm.

choices.text: Tactical retreat to advance, feigning confession then launching a desperate counterattack
choices.description: First show weakness to make them lower their guard, then reveal your trump card at their most triumphant moment to maximize their humiliation
choices.visible_reward: Nail them to the pillar of shame, forever unable to rise
choices.risk_hint: Without help to turn the tables, it might backfire

text.content: What? The entire arena erupted in shock. This waste actually confessed directly? Zhou Heng froze for an instant, then ecstasy flooded his heart. Just as he was about to speak in triumph, Chen Ji slowly raised his head, and that perpetually timid pair of eyes suddenly flashed with a chilling light that sent shivers down everyone's spine. "Disciple pleads guilty—" Chen Ji's voice suddenly turned ice-cold, "—guilty of being framed, of suffering an unjust accusation!" He spun around, pointing at Zhou Heng. "Disciple pleads guilty to YOUR crimes, you jumping clown, for spreading rumors and betraying the sect before everyone!" The sudden shift in aura left everyone stunned.

The Truth Verification Formation's runes suddenly violently trembled, a blinding golden light rising from beneath Chen Ji's feet—this was the formation confirming his statement was no lie. The surroundings erupted instantly. "He's not lying?" "Could it be Zhou Heng who was framing him?" "What... what exactly is going on?" Zhou Heng's face turned deathly pale, his lips quivering as he couldn't get a word out. Ling Yuan's pupils slightly contracted, his gaze toward Chen Ji carrying a new layer of scrutiny and wariness. This waste... when did he become so troublesome?

Right then, a cold voice suddenly rang out from the crowd: "Since Chen Junior says Zhou Heng framed him, why not verify the spiritual energy on the spot? If that demonic path fragment truly involves him, it will naturally be exposed; if not... Zhou Junior, you should preserve some dignity for yourself." Everyone turned to see, and a woman in Inner Sect robes slowly walked out—it was Su Qingyao. Her gaze fell on Chen Ji, a complex light flickering in her eyes—scrutiny, and also probing. This waste junior brother was indeed not as simple as he appeared.

Ling Yuan remained silent for a moment, then finally nodded: "Very well. Someone, present the evidence for an on-site spiritual verification!" Zhou Heng was struck like lightning, the jade box in his hand nearly falling. He下意识地looked toward Ling Yuan, but the Sect Master merely shook his head slightly, his gaze ice-cold with not a trace of warmth. At that moment, Zhou Heng suddenly realized—he might have been nothing more than a chess piece to be used from the very beginning. And the true mastermind was currently seated high on the Sect Master's throne, coldly watching it all unfold. The jade box opened, and the so-called demonic path fragment was placed into the Spiritual Verification Formation. A ghostly blue light flickered, and the runes began to analyze the fragment's aura.

The Spiritual Verification Formation's results came quickly. The runes indicated that the aura remaining on the fragment indeed belonged to demonic path techniques—but it was completely opposite to Chen Ji's spiritual root attribute. An Inner Disciple Senior Fellow at Foundation Building stage announced on the spot: "Reporting to the Sect Master, the Spiritual Verification Formation indicates that the demonic aura on this fragment has a compatibility opposition of over ninety percent with Chen Ji Junior's spiritual root. A normal person could not leave spiritual traces on a technique that contradicts their own spiritual root." This declaration caused an uproar throughout the arena. Zhou Heng's legs went weak, and he collapsed directly to the ground, his face as pale as paper.

Chen Ji stood in place, gazing with a look of pity at the collapsed Zhou Heng, his voice so soft it seemed only the two of them could hear: "Senior Brother Zhou, we had no grudges in the past, no conflicts recently. Why did you want to destroy me? Was someone pressuring you, or... did you think you could gain something from this?" Zhou Heng shuddered all over, his panicked gaze flickering toward where Ling Yuan stood. That glance did not escape Chen Ji's notice. He sneered internally—exactly as he thought. Ling Yuan, Ling Yuan, you thought you had made a perfect plan, but even the most careful schemes have inevitable cracks.

The interrogation came to an abrupt end. Ling Yuan announced Chen Ji's innocence with an impassive face, but did not pursue Zhou Heng's crime of false accusation, merely stating he was "misled by others" and was given a light sentence. The crowd gradually dispersed, but the discussions continued unabated. Chen Ji lowered his head and returned to the Servants' Quarters. The moment the door closed, a cold smile curved his lips. The person who filed the false accusation was merely a discarded pawn; the true opponent still sat calmly at the chessboard. This small victory was merely the brief calm before the storm. The shadow of the Holy Sect, Ling Yuan's machinations, the gaze of the Heavenly Secrets Eye... it was all just beginning.

As night fell, Chen Ji once again sat cross-legged. This time, he did not recklessly connect to the Tianji Record. Instead, he focused his attention on the jade slip hidden in his sleeve. The mysterious person had said this jade slip contained a tracking prohibition sealed within. That prohibition's structure was extremely intricate, impossible to dissolve through ordinary means. But for Chen Ji, who possessed a fragment of the Tianji Record, there might be another way. He carefully injected a thread of Tianji Record's aura into the jade slip. That aura seemed alive, gliding along the prohibition's patterns. After a moment, a faint point of light appeared in Chen Ji's mind—that was the source coordinates of the prohibition, pointing to a remote courtyard in the northwestern corner of the Tianqing Sect.
